infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: COCO uses your camera to capture climb photos and videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: COCO saves climb photos and videos to your library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: COCO uses your microphone to record climb videos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: COCO uses your location to tag your climbing sessions with the gym or crag you're at.
